deviations.decision: Keep month and single-day views only; remove multi-calendar, week, three-day and list views. Reuse the single trailing view-indicator control to switch the two retained modes.
deviations.approval_basis: User-approved product scope before the source-driven rebuild.

deviations.decision: Use Sunday as the first day of the week.
Each active Android main tab owns one exported Expo native root and keeps its bottom bar inside that native tree.
deviations.approval_basis: Required platform adaptation preserving Feishu single-tree composition behavior.

deviations.decision: Retain LaoJi voice schedule creation while sourcing its container and motion from the closest Feishu interaction contract.
Use LaoJi Qwen ASR, summary, WAV persistence and Media3 playback in Feishu-derived Minutes containers.
deviations.approval_basis: Feishu proprietary RTC, CCM and player services are outside LaoJi service capabilities.

deviations.decision: Retain real guest-mode meeting summaries with the existing LaoJi privacy boundary.
Replace Feishu CCM collaboration sharing with system file sharing for meeting documents, transcripts, summaries and recordings.
deviations.approval_basis: Explicit user requirement and current service boundary.

deviations.decision: Version one supports the Feishu-derived light theme only.
